**User Journey 1: Migrating Existing Users with SSO**

1. **Pre-Migration**: The existing user receives a notification about the upcoming migration to Auth0, specifying the benefits and requirements for the transition (4 syllables: ex-is-ting-uents-re-cep-tion).
2. **SSO Setup**: The user logs in to their existing system and navigates to the SSO setup page, where they enter their credentials and authorize the connection to Auth0 (7 syllables: sys-tem-log-in-cre-den-tials-au-thor-i-ze).
3. **SSO Configuration**: The user configures their SSO settings, including the authentication method, redirect URI, and scope (8 syllables: au-then-ti-ca-tion-method-re-direct-URI-scope).
4. **Migration Initiation**: The user initiates the migration process, which may involve a brief downtime or a seamless transition, depending on the implementation (10 syllables: mi-gra-tion-i-ni-ta-tion-pro-cess-brief-dow-n-time-seam-less).
5. **Post-Migration**: The user is redirected to the Auth0 login page, where they enter their credentials and complete the authentication process (9 syllables: au-tho-ri-za-tion-pro-cess-com-plete).

**User Journey 2: Migrating Users to Native Auth0 Authentication**

1. **Pre-Migration**: The user receives a notification about the upcoming migration to native Auth0 authentication, specifying the benefits and requirements for the transition (8 syllables: au-tho-ri-za-tion-meth-od-native-trans-i-tion).
2. **Native Auth0 Setup**: The user logs in to their Auth0 account and navigates to the native authentication setup page, where they configure their authentication settings (10 syllables: au-tho-ri-za-tion-set-tings-au-tho-ac-count-na-tive).
3. **Native Auth0 Configuration**: The user configures their native Auth0 settings, including the authentication method, redirect URI, and scope (11 syllables: au-tho-ri-za-tion-method-re-direct-URI-scope-na-tive).
4. **Migration Initiation**: The user initiates the migration process, which may involve a brief downtime or a seamless transition, depending on the implementation (12 syllables: au-tho-ri-za-tion-meth-od-mi-gra-tion-i-ni-ta-tion-pro-cess-brief-dow-n-time-seam-less).
5. **Post-Migration**: The user is redirected to the Auth0 login page, where they enter their credentials and complete the authentication process (10 syllables: au-tho-ri-za-tion-pro-cess-com-plete-na-tive).

**User Journey 3: Onboarding New Users with Access to Multiple Products**

1. **Pre-Onboarding**: The new user receives a notification about the onboarding process, specifying the benefits and requirements for access to multiple products (10 syllables: on-board-ing-pre-cep-tion-ben-e-fits-re-qui-ri-ments-ac-cess-mul-ti-ple-pro-ducts).
2. **Product Selection**: The user selects the products they wish to access, which may involve a guided tour or a self-service interface (11 syllables: pro-duct-selec-tion-guid-ed-tour-self-ser-vice-in-ter-face).
3. **Account Creation**: The user creates their account, which may involve providing personal and contact information, as well as setting up their password and security questions (12 syllables: ac-count-cre-a-tion-per-son-al-in-for-ma-tion-con-tact-in-for-ma-tion-pas-word-and-se-cu-ri-ty-ques-tions).
4. **Access Granting**: The user is granted access to the selected products, which may involve a brief setup process or a seamless integration (11 syllables: ac-cess-gran-ting-brief-set-up-pro-cess-seam-less-in-te-gra-tion).
5. **Post-Onboarding**: The user is notified about the completion of the onboarding process, which may involve a welcome message or a tutorial on product usage (10 syllables: post-on-board-ing-com-ple-tion-wel-come-mes-sage-or-tu-to-ri-al-on-pro-duct-u-sage).

Please review these user journeys and let me know if you need any further amendments.
